name: 蟠螭展岳
type: 玄螭镇岳特殊专属护手
scope: 只制作效果设计图；尚未制作模型、导入或替换UE资产。
design: 保留中央青玉、亮铜深色凹槽和蟠螭云纹，左右延长、末端上扬。图中比例为概念表达，实际接口和跨度建模时以原厂护手为准。
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, reference-guided game weapon accessory design.
Create ONE polished landscape concept art sheet for a unique SPECIAL crossguard modification for the Chinese two-handed jian "玄螭镇岳". Chinese title EXACTLY "蟠螭展岳", small subtitle EXACTLY "特殊 · 专属护手". This is a conceptual product render, NOT a game screenshot.
Reference roles: first image shows the original sword and stock guard structure; second image shows the accepted visual presentation and antique bronze/gold craftsmanship. Redesign ONLY the crossguard. Keep the original central round turquoise jade cabochon, its bezel, the tall central blade-collar relief, original Chinese coiled chi-dragon/cloud-scroll carving vocabulary, black wrapped grip and silver blade. Current metal preference is luminous warm polished COPPER-BRONZE raised edges and dark bronze recesses, not flat black, white metal or yellow plastic.
Main requested change: extend the LEFT AND RIGHT crossguard arms symmetrically sideways to approximately 1.65 times the original total span, by continuing and developing the existing continuous sculpted cloud-scroll curves. Do not simply scale the whole guard: the center, jewel, blade collar and grip interface stay original size. Each wing extends as a substantial tapering cast bronze arm with flowing chi-dragon bas-relief, a subtle shallow openwork channel framed by solid metal, ending in an elegant rounded upward curl. A clear broad horizontal silhouette, upward swept tips, Chinese ritual sword character. No feathers, literal bird wings, enormous dragon skulls, spikes pointing into the hand, extra jewels, shields, chains, symbols or magic particles. Retain generous usable grip clearance under the guard. Convincing volumetric cast metal thickness, underside bevels, continuous smooth attachment to blade and grip; engraved grooves and raised ridges with readable depth, refined worn corners, pale verdigris only deep in protected recesses.
Composition: charcoal gray studio-paper background, tasteful restrained premium concept sheet. Main upper/central 75 percent of canvas: a VERY LARGE near-frontal three-quarter close-up of the newly extended guard mounted on a short section of the vertical blade rising upwards and the black grip below. Both guard tips entirely in frame with margins. Jade and central collar clearly visible, camera only 12 degrees angled to reveal real thickness without concealing left-right symmetry. Show enough silver blade and black grip to judge attachment and scale. Lower strip: one smaller full-length assembled sword with this SAME guard, blade tip left and original circular pommel / jade / red tassel right, demonstrating overall proportions; keep this subordinate, long blade remains a two-handed jian. Apart from the guard use the existing stock silver blade with fine etched cloud ornament, no new scripture design, no blade color change. No hands, character or UI. Upper left small title block in elegant Chinese calligraphy, ample uncluttered dark space. High fidelity photoreal PBR concept rendering, soft directional studio highlights distinguish bright copper and cool jade, crisp engraved relief, no bloom that obscures surfaces, no excessive wear. One consistent design across both views.
